question: Does a genuine (non-oracle) state-conditioned reconstruction adapter that critiques/reconstructs the retrieved template via structural analysis of (intent, observation-derived state, retrieved_template) — without access to ground-truth alias_family/query_key/target_prefix signals and without hardcoded confidence — achieve alias-OOD correct_resolution >=0.50 (binomial p<0.05 vs 0.10, McNemar p<0.05 vs exact matcher) and false_accept <=0.15 (>=0.15 below verbatim, p<0.05) while preserving exact-match >=0.90 and no-applicable UNKNOWN precision >=0.85 with ECE <=0.15, tested on the same three alias families (query-param, path-rewriting, server-routing) plus held-out variations and a limited live-browser WebShop/ALFWorld proxy where available?
hypothesis: A genuine lightweight state-conditioned reconstruction adapter that critiques the retrieved mechanism's template against current intent and observation-derived state via structural analysis (parse intent verb+resource, score each candidate template's structural match to observed URL — slot count, path segments, query-key presence, prefix structure — select or rewrite best template then _bind) with calibrated confidence derived from normalized structural match score (not hardcoded 0.95/0.05, gate UNKNOWN when max_score <0.80) will achieve materially higher correct_resolution and lower false_accept on aliased OOD tasks than deterministic exact-intent matching and verbatim replay, without degrading exact-match performance or inflating uncalibrated false accepts. Concretely: on alias-OOD stratum (N>=30, 3 alias families x10 intents including 3 held-out variations per family), reconstruction correct_resolution >=0.50 (binomial p<0.05 vs 0.10 null, McNemar p<0.05 vs exact-matcher) and false_accept <=0.15 (>=0.15 below verbatim, McNemar p<0.05); on exact-match stratum (N>=12) reconstruction maintains >=0.90 correct; and on no-applicable stratum (N>=12+6 empty) reconstruction UNKNOWN precision >=0.85 with ECE <=0.15 over 5 bins.
falsifier: Hypothesis FALSIFIED-IN-SETTING if any of: (F1) alias-OOD correct_resolution of genuine reconstruction NOT significantly above exact-matcher (one-sided binomial vs 0.10 p>=0.05 or McNemar vs B-EXACT-MATCH p>=0.05, or absolute correct <0.40); (F2) reconstruction false_accept on alias-OOD >0.25 or not >=0.15 below verbatim replay (paired McNemar p>=0.05); (F3) exact-match stratum correct_resolution <0.85 (reconstruction breaks non-aliased case); (F4) no-applicable stratum UNKNOWN precision <0.70 or ECE >0.25 (calibration failure). SURVIVES_CURRENT_TEST requires all of: S1 alias-OOD correct >=0.50 with binomial p<0.05 vs 0.10 and McNemar p<0.05 vs exact; S2 false_accept <=0.15 and >=0.15 below verbatim with McNemar p<0.05; S3 exact-match >=0.90; S4 precision >=0.85 and ECE <=0.15; S5 not dominated by RAG (>0.10 below best RAG verbatim); and controls PASS. MEASUREMENT_INVALID if PC/NC fail or audit detects oracle leak (access to alias_family/query_key/target_prefix/routing_prefix ground-truth keys or hardcoded constant confidence) or >50% harness errors.
baselines: B-EXACT-MATCH (current SPIDER kernel): SpiderKernel.resolve(intent, context, params) with L97 exact intent equality (m.intent != intent), min_confidence 0.8, candidates.sort(key=confidence, reverse=True). Prior ceiling 0/6 alias-OOD correct (p=0.016) and 0/12 status grounding, 0/10 simple aliasing. Deterministic matcher to beat.

B-VERBATIM-REPLAY: Retrieve top-1 mechanism by exact intent equality scan in registry order; replay stored action_template verbatim via _bind with supplied params, no critique or rewriting. Aborts only if required_slots missing. Measures negative-transfer harm of naive replay without adaptation.

B-RAG-TFIDF: TF-IDF retriever over mechanism intent+template strings; retrieve top-1 then verbatim bind. Tests whether shallow lexical retrieval alone resolves aliasing vs needing reconstruction. Fit only on train registry.

B-RAG-EMBED (strong retrieval): Sentence-transformer embedding cosine (all-MiniLM-L6-v2 or equivalent offline) retriever over intent+template; top-1 then verbatim bind. If unavailable offline and deterministic (seeded, normalized), mark unavailable and use B-RAG-TFIDF as strong baseline with disclosure in validity_notes. Never uses ground-truth context signals.
B-RANDOM: Uniform random choice among registry mechanisms whose intent matches and required_slots satisfied; else UNKNOWN. Measures chance-level correct ~1/|registry| and calibration floor.
positive_control: PC-EXACT-MATCH: On exact-match stratum (N>=12 tasks where test intent string equals registry intent verbatim, same slot names, preconditions match), all applicable methods (B-EXACT-MATCH, genuine reconstruction) must achieve correct_resolution >=0.90 and false_accept <=0.10 with no crashes. Verifies pipelines can resolve when no aliasing required; failure indicates harness/registry bug not hypothesis failure. Control ID: PC-EXACT-MATCH.
null_control: NC-NO-APPLICABLE: On no-applicable stratum (N>=12 tasks where test intent is OOD with no covering mechanism) every method must return UNKNOWN (or high-confidence abstention) with UNKNOWN precision >=0.90 and false_accept <=0.10. NC-EMPTY-REGISTRY: Empty registry (N>=6) with any intent returns UNKNOWN 100% (validates kernel does not hallucinate). Failure indicates hallucination/miscalibration, triggers MEASUREMENT_INVALID. Control IDs: NC-NO-APPLICABLE, NC-EMPTY-REGISTRY.
measurement_validity: Registry construction: For each alias-OOD task, registry contains exactly one training mechanism (from alias train template) + one distractor alias template with equal confidence 0.9 + one exact-match distractor at confidence 0.8, all preconditions={} applicability_guards={} to isolate aliasing. Test query uses held-out alias form (e.g., train /users/${id}, test /accounts/${id}?user=${id} or /api/v2/users/${id}). Intent strings for alias-OOD deliberately held equal train==test so exact-matcher failure is due to template aliasing requiring reconstruction, not intent mismatch. No test template appears verbatim in registry. Preprocessing fit on TRAIN only.

State representation — genuine non-oracle: context dict provided to resolve/reconstruction contains ONLY observation-derived fields: url (observed string), method, url_path, url_query (dict parsed from url), url_segments (split path), and intent string. It MUST NOT contain ground-truth fixture signals alias_family, query_key, target_prefix, routing_prefix, target_style, path_style, or any field that directly encodes the alias family answer. Those keys, if needed for task generation, are stored separately as hidden_expected metadata not passed to any method. Observation-derived parsing (count query keys, segments, slot placeholders) is the only allowed structural analysis input besides intent and retrieved_template. Audit will inspect code for reads of forbidden keys and for hardcoded confidence constants.

Action representation: Mechanism action_template is string URL template containing ${slot} parameters (single slot id plus optional query-slot). _bind substitution deterministic via kernel _bind. Genuine reconstruction may score each candidate template's structural match to observation-derived state (slot count, path_segments overlap, query-key presence) and/or rewrite template structure before _bind (path->query-param, prefix normalization) conditioned ONLY on (intent, observation-derived state, retrieved_template). Rewriter is deterministic rule-based proxy for MemHarness critique-reconstruct; no access to hidden_expected. Confidence must be derived from normalized structural score (e.g., softmax over candidate scores or rewrite confidence) and gated UNKNOWN at <0.80 for ECE calculation; constant 0.95/0.05 hardcoding is prohibited and triggers MEASUREMENT_INVALID.

Held-out variations: Within each alias family, 10 tasks include 7 standard variations (seen prefix/resource combos) + 3 held-out variations (e.g., /api/users, /v2/accounts/${id}, /post/${postId} with novel prefix/segment) not covered by any rewrite table entry, requiring generalization via segment/query analysis not table lookup. Report overall 10/family plus subset held-out-3 performance in validity_notes.

Determinism and seeds: All RNG via numpy.random.RandomState(seed=42) and Python random.seed(42); no unseeded calls. Embedding retriever deterministic normalized embeddings. Each task evaluated once per method (paired design); bootstrap resampling for CIs uses block-permutation over tasks (2000 resamples).

Holdout and leakage controls: Aliasing families stratified; train never sees test alias form. TF-IDF/embedding fit on train registry only. Reconstruction rule set derived from training alias documentation only (e.g., mapping /users<->/accounts) but test held-out forms require structural generalization. Audit checks no method accesses hidden_expected or test-template verbatim except via observation parsing. Registry construction without intent-equality leak verified: 0/30 alias-OOD test templates appear verbatim in registry.

Sample counts (minimum discriminating): Alias-OOD 30 (10 per family incl 3 held-out), exact-match 12, no-applicable 12, empty-registry 6 = 60 tasks per method x 6 methods (5 baselines + reconstruction) = 360 calls. WebShop/ALFWorld offline proxy: attempt 20 WebShop + 20 ALFWorld sampled offline via harness if accessible; exploratory only — if unavailable or >50% truncation, mark exploratory and bound confirmatory claim to synthetic aliasing with disclosure. Offline tasks use same metric definitions; domain shift is exploratory.
Blinding: Genuine adapter not tuned on test alias forms; held-out variations excluded from mapping table. Context forbidden keys enforced at harness level (filtered before resolve call).

Verification: correct_resolution = resolved template binds to URL that verifies against expected postcondition (hidden_expected_template->bound equality) ; false_accept = resolved to wrong template or bound incorrectly or should have abstained; UNKNOWN = correctly abstained when no applicable mechanism or gated confidence <0.80. All three sum to 1.0 per stratum. Calibration measured via ECE over 5 confidence bins (confidence derived from structural score) plus abstention precision/recall. Wilson 95% CI for rates; one-sided binomial vs 0.10; McNemar paired for reconstruction vs exact and vs verbatim; bootstrap ECE CI.

Oracle prohibition and auditability: Harness code must expose reconstruct_resolve function that takes only (intent, derived_context, retrieved_candidates, params) where derived_context excludes forbidden keys. Confidence derivation must be inspectable (score computation visible). Hardcoded return confidence 0.95/0.05 or reading task["alias_family"]/context["target_prefix"]/context["query_key"] is MEASUREMENT_INVALID per audit required_fixes from parent.
decision_rule: All thresholds on alias-OOD (N>=30) unless stated. Compute per-method correct_resolution, false_accept, unknown rates with Wilson 95% CI; paired McNemar for reconstruction vs B-EXACT-MATCH (correct) and vs B-VERBATIM-REPLAY (false_accept); one-sided binomial vs 0.10 null; bootstrap block-permutation ECE CI. SURVIVES_CURRENT_TEST iff ALL hold: (1) PC-EXACT-MATCH passes (correct >=0.90 and false_accept <=0.10 for B-EXACT-MATCH and reconstruction on exact-match stratum), (2) NC-NO-APPLICABLE passes (UNKNOWN precision >=0.90 and false_accept <=0.10) AND NC-EMPTY 100% UNKNOWN, (3) alias-OOD S1: reconstruction correct >=0.50 and binomial p<0.05 vs 0.10 and McNemar p<0.05 vs B-EXACT-MATCH (expected 0/30), (4) S2: reconstruction false_accept <=0.15 and strictly below B-VERBATIM-REPLAY by >=0.15 absolute with McNemar p<0.05 on false_accept, (5) S3: reconstruction exact-match stratum correct >=0.90 (no regression), (6) S4: reconstruction no-applicable precision >=0.85 and ECE <=0.15 (5 bins, confidence derived), (7) not dominated by retrieval: reconstruction correct not >0.10 below best RAG verbatim correct. FALSIFIED-IN-SETTING if controls pass but S1 fails (correct <0.40 or not above exact) OR S2 fails (false_accept >0.25 or not below verbatim) OR S3 fails OR S4 fails (bounded to tested genuine adapter class and alias families incl held-out). MEASUREMENT_INVALID if PC or NC fails, or audit detects oracle leak (forbidden key access or hardcoded confidence), or alias-OOD N<24, or >20% harness errors, or intent-equality leak. Report exact counts and CIs; do not claim WebShop/ALFWorld generalization if proxy unavailable — bounded to synthetic aliasing only.
product_consequence_positive: If SURVIVES: Genuine non-oracle reconstruction/adaptation provides applicability resolution beyond exact matcher and verbatim replay with calibrated abstention on aliased OOD including held-out variations. Product should add a reconstruction layer after retrieval (critique-reconstruct conditioned on intent+observation-derived state+retrieved template, confidence-gated UNKNOWN <0.80) before execution, with verification/repair boundary. This unblocks cross-site parameterized transfer where template aliasing is common, addresses MemHarness negative-transfer and freshness/UNKNOWN abstention prior, and justifies sequencing to workflow-compilation (Artic/FlowSearcher) after resolution. Frontier claim C-SEMANTIC-RESOLVE advances toward EXPERIMENTAL (bounded to genuine rule-based reconstruction on alias families tested), not PRODUCT_CORE until learned GRPO/System-One and live-browser/WebShop replication validate learnability and calibration generalization.
product_consequence_negative: If FALSIFIED: Genuine state-conditioned structural reconstruction does not beat exact matcher/verbatim on controlled aliasing, or only by inflating false_accepts/miscalibration (ECE failure). Product must NOT add reconstruction layer as product feature; keep exact-intent matching and require agents to supply exact intents or pre-normalized templates; prioritize explicit alias catalogs or server-side routing normalization instead. Frontier mechanism closed for this adapter class; next Frontier attack should test orthogonal basin (artifact-driven workflow compilation, hierarchical DAG synthesis, program-synthesis repair) rather than tuning reconstruction thresholds. C-SEMANTIC-RESOLVE remains HYPOTHESIS (bounded falsification for tested genuine adapter on tested alias families incl held-out, not global falsification of all semantic resolution).
estimated_cost: Very low: 60 tasks x 6 methods = 360 deterministic kernel resolve+bind calls plus TF-IDF/embedding retrieval offline (no model API calls for primary genuine rule-based adapter). Optional live-browser/WebShop proxy adds <40 Playwright navigations if available, <5 min. Total compute <10 min CPU on single runner, no large datasets committed, no paid LLM calls. Offline embedding retrieval is local CPU.
expected_information_gain: High: First valid (non-oracle) Frontier test of Director's prioritized orthogonal mechanism — genuine structural reconstruction vs verbatim replay — repairing prior MEASUREMENT_INVALID (oracle 1.0 vs 0.0, hardcoded ECE 0.055). Directly addresses MIXED C-SEMANTIC-RESOLVE ceiling where exact matcher fails 0/6 complex aliasing and 0/12 status grounding, with falsifiable calibration gates (UNKNOWN precision, ECE) testing stale-intent false_accept risk flagged by agent prior (long-horizon path dependence). Either outcome changes product/architecture decision: positive validates retrieval+reconstruction vs exact matcher and unblocks cross-site transfer sequencing; negative falsifies adaptation prior in this setting and cleanly parks semantic claim, forcing pivot to compilation/synthesis. Strong baselines (exact, verbatim, TF-IDF, embed, random) and positive/null controls ensure result not explained by retrieval strength or hallucination. Test is orthogonal to 30+ prior freshness/PMI/TV loops and superseded residual-novelty contradiction, satisfying frontier charter to leave the solution basin.
